features.label: Sizing and fit
features.text: Order the same size as your Rebound Dual ST brace, XS to 3XL, so the liner kit matches your frame exactly.

features.label: Replacement liner kit
features.text: Off the shelf soft goods set built for the Ossur Rebound Dual ST knee brace.

features.label: Doeskin thigh liner
features.text: Soft fabric liner cushions the thigh section of the frame against the skin.

features.label: Sensil calf liner
features.text: Moisture managing calf liner reduces friction between the calf and the rigid frame.

features.label: Easy swap installation
features.text: Liners fit inside the brace frame in place of worn or damaged factory liners.

features.label: Black colorway
features.text: Liner kit is finished in black to match the standard Rebound Dual ST frame.

features.label: Built for ligament support braces
features.text: Designed for braces fitted for combined and non-combined instabilities of the ACL, MCL, LCL, and PCL.

features.label: Hand wash care
features.text: Hand wash with mild detergent, rinse thoroughly, and air dry.

features.label: Accessory only
features.text: This listing is for the liner kit only, the Rebound Dual ST brace frame is not included.

features.label: Perfect fit guarantee
features.text: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with US-based brace specialists.

measurement: Order the same size as your Rebound Dual ST brace. Brace sizing is based on knee caliper width and thigh circumference. Measure knee caliper medio laterally at joint width in a standing, weight bearing position; measure thigh circumference 15 cm (6 in.) above mid patella with the leg in extension. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
